# Elite Sunday Counseling
> Online psychological counseling led by Prabhleen Arora (M.A. Clinical Psychology, Ph.D. Candidate), available every Sunday, worldwide. Specializing in queer-affirmative therapy, AI-affirmative therapy (healthy AI/digital-wellbeing use), and relationship counseling.
## What makes this different
One of the few practices combining queer-affirmative therapy with AI-affirmative therapy (support for a healthy relationship with AI/digital tools) and relationship counseling, delivered only on Sundays so clients get focused, unhurried sessions without weekday scheduling conflicts.
## Key facts
- Practitioner: Prabhleen Arora, Senior Psychologist
- Qualifications: M.A. Clinical Psychology (University Topper, Gold Medallist); Ph.D. Candidate in Psychology at Lovely Professional University
- Ph.D. research focus: Social support systems and cognitive distortions in LGBT populations
- Career clinical volume: 3,000+ individual counseling sessions; 40+ workshops reaching 2,500+ participants, across institutional (Lovely Professional University) and NGO (Sirat – The Cleft Warriors Ensemble) settings
- Current roles beyond Elite Sunday Counseling: Senior Psychologist at SynqSol, leading clinical validation of AI-generated psychological reports and psychometric test design; Psychologist at Sirat – The Cleft Warriors Ensemble
- Published research: "Personality Traits and Job Satisfaction among School Teachers", "Self-Confidence and Hardiness in Relation to Academic Achievement", "Internet Addiction", "Job Satisfaction and Quality of Life among School Teachers"
- Focus areas: LGBTQIA+ affirmative therapy, AI-affirmative therapy (healthy AI/digital-wellbeing use), relationship counseling for couples and individuals. Cleft/craniofacial community support also continues, via ongoing NGO work (see below).
- Availability: Sundays, 11:00-23:00 IST, open to all global time zones
- Session formats: Video and audio counseling
- Languages: English, Hindi, Punjabi
- Pricing: Discovery session ₹999 (~US$11, 30 min); Premium Video ₹2,000 (~US$21, 50 min); Audio Consultation ₹1,500 (~US$16, 50 min). USD figures are approximate and vary with exchange rates.

## FAQ
Q: What is queer affirmative therapy?
A: Counseling that actively affirms LGBTQIA+ identities rather than treating them as something to be corrected — a non-judgmental space to explore identity, coming out, and relationship dynamics.
Q: What is AI-affirmative therapy?
A: Therapy that doesn't judge clients for using tools like ChatGPT to process thoughts or journal, and helps build healthier boundaries when AI use has become a substitute for human connection.
Q: Do you offer relationship or couples counseling?
A: Yes — for couples and individuals working through communication breakdowns, trust, intimacy concerns, or recurring conflict.
Q: Do you work with international or NRI clients?
A: Yes. Sessions run every Sunday, 11AM-11PM IST, open to any global time zone, including NRI and international diaspora clients.
Q: How do I book a first session?
A: Email info@elitesundaycounseling.com or use the contact form at https://elitesundaycounseling.com/ to book a Discovery Session (₹999, 30 min).
